meta_data.base_class: Retrieve the current standing of a team in a <team-based professional sport> league - refers to any sport that is structured around competing teams in formal leagues where seasonal rankings are maintained.

tool_template.name: <class>_team.standing
tool_template.description: Retrieve the current standing of a <class> team in its respective league.

league.description: The <class> league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed.

region.description: The geographical region of the <class> league to specify where the team competes.

include_playoffs.description: A flag indicating whether the standings should include playoff results for the <class> league.

include_friendly_matches.description: A flag indicating whether friendly matches should be considered in the standing of the <class> team.

home_away.description: Specify whether to retrieve standings based on home, away, or combined performance of the <class> team.
